metadata.title: Create Android Subscription Introductory Offer
metadata.description: Learn how to create introductory offers for auto-renewable subscriptions on Android to attract new subscribers.

blocks.text: Introductory offers allow you to provide eligible users with either a free trial or a discounted introductory price. After the introductory period concludes, subscriptions automatically renew at standard pricing unless cancelled.
Introductory offers are a powerful tool to:
Reduce barriers to entry for new subscribers
Allow users to try your premium features risk-free
Users can receive an introductory offer if they haven't previously purchased or received an introductory offer for the subscription. Google Play handles eligibility automatically.
